sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想起当年还在黑胶时代夜店里当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着300件你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个像微型流行快闪博物馆一样的地方，摆满了那些美丽且有50年历史的藏品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, President Trump says he will announce today whether he'll withdraw the United States from the Paris Climate Accord,
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统表示他将于今天宣布是否会将美国撤出《巴黎气候协定》，

sentences.en: what it means for the biggest contributor to climate change to abandon the most ambitious effort to solve it,
sentences.zh: 气候变化最大的制造者放弃解决这一问题最雄心勃勃的努力意味着什么，

sentences.en: and what that decision could do to an international coalition that depends on a surprisingly powerful force, peer pressure.
sentences.zh: 以及这一决定将对一个依赖于某种出奇强大的力量——同辈压力的国际联盟产生什么影响。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月1日，星期四。

sentences.en: Justin Gillis, thank you for coming on.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀·吉利斯，谢谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: So where are you, by the way?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，你现在在哪儿？

sentences.en: I am in a car, parked at the moment, but on my way into the Sierra Nevada to look at the remains or the aftermath of one of the largest fires in California history.
sentences.zh: 我在车里，目前正停着，不过正在前往内华达山脉的路上，去查看加州历史上最大火灾之一的废墟或灾后状况。

sentences.en: And I presume that is related to your beat of covering the environment.
sentences.zh: 我想这与你负责的环境报道领域有关。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Climate change is causing more fires, we think, on the landscape.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，气候变化正在导致地表发生更多的火灾。

sentences.en: And so we've got to wrap our hands around exactly what's happening.
sentences.zh: 因此我们必须弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, on that note, the reason we're talking to you now is to understand just how much of the problem here is the United States when it comes to climate change.
sentences.zh: 那么顺着这个话题，我们现在采访你的原因，是想了解在气候变化问题上，美国到底占了多大比例的问题。

sentences.en: What's the answer?
sentences.zh: 答案是什么？

sentences.en: The short answer is that climate change or global warming is really a problem that ought to come with a Made in America sticker.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是，气候变化或全球变暖确实是一个应该贴上“美国制造”标签的问题。

sentences.en: If you look at the history over the whole industrial era, the United States has burned far more fossil fuels than any other country.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看整个工业时代的风雨历程，美国燃烧的化石燃料远远超过其他任何国家。

sentences.en: So when you add it all up, we are responsible.
sentences.zh: 所以总算下来，我们难辞其咎。

sentences.en: The United States is responsible for almost a third of the excess carbon dioxide that's in the atmosphere and that is heating the planet.
sentences.zh: 美国应对大气中近三分之一的过量二氧化碳负有责任，正是这些二氧化碳正在使地球变暖。

sentences.en: If you were to take the 28 countries of the European Union and put them together, they would nearly equal us.
sentences.zh: 如果你把欧盟的28个成员国加在一起，他们的排放量几乎与我们相当。

sentences.en: But we basically outrank all other individual countries in our contribution to this problem.
sentences.zh: 但在对这一问题的贡献上，我们基本上排在所有单个国家的前列。

sentences.en: So given the outsized role that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 鉴于美国在造成气候变化问题上所起到的过大作用，

sentences.en: has played in creating the problem of climate change, what has historically been the expectation that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 历史上人们对美国在帮助解决该问题上发挥作用的期望是什么？

sentences.en: will play in helping to solve it?
sentences.zh: 在帮助解决这个问题时起到作用？

sentences.en: We've had 25 years of substantially fruitless climate negotiations in which one of the huge sticking points was inequity between the rich countries and the poor countries.
sentences.zh: 在过去的25年里，我们进行了实质上毫无成果的气候谈判，其中一个巨大的争端焦点就是富裕国家与贫穷国家之间的不平等。

sentences.en: There was always, I think, a recognition on the part of the rich countries that they had to go first in reducing emissions, that they had to spend money to help the poor countries.
sentences.zh: 我认为富裕国家一直有一种共识，即他们在减少排放方面必须率先垂行动，他们必须花钱帮助贫穷国家。

sentences.en: But exactly who needed to do what and how quickly and who needed to spend how much money has been a huge global diplomatic and political fight now for decades.
sentences.zh: 但究竟谁需要做什么、速度有多快以及谁需要花多少钱，几十年来一直是全球外交和政治上的一场巨大博弈。

sentences.en: And it's essentially the thing that stopped any real progress up until the agreement in Paris that was negotiated in late 2015.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，正是这件事阻止了任何真正的进展，直到2015年底谈判达成《巴黎协定》。

sentences.en: We're living in a historic moment.
sentences.zh: 我们正生活在一个历史性的时刻。

sentences.en: France is now hosting 150 heads of state and government from every continent.
sentences.zh: 法国目前正在接待来自各大洲的150位国家元首和政府首脑。

sentences.en: And how does that agreement, the 2015 Paris Climate Agreement, how does it connect to America's role in helping to create the problem?
sentences.zh: 那么该协议，即2015年的《巴黎气候协定》，它与美国在制造该问题过程中的角色有何联系？

sentences.en: That agreement basically said, OK, we're not going to try any longer, as we had been doing for many years,
sentences.zh: 该协议基本上是说，好吧，我们不再像多年来一直在做的那样去尝试，

sentences.en: to have the United Nations or the global community impose targets and timetables on countries.
sentences.zh: 让联合国或国际社会对各个国家强加目标和时间表。

sentences.en: Instead, everybody just come with your best effort and tell us what you're willing to do.
sentences.zh: 相反，每个人都只需带着你最大的努力来，告诉我们你愿意做什么。

sentences.en: Russia will continue contributing to joint efforts aimed at preventing global warming.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯将继续为旨在防止全球变暖的联合努力做出贡献。

sentences.en: And paradoxically, where before you had very low ambition for most countries, suddenly that opened up the floodgates of ambition.
sentences.zh: 矛盾的是，以前大多数国家的雄心都非常低，而突然之间，这就打开了雄心壮志的闸门。

sentences.en: We have set ambitious targets by 2030.
sentences.zh: 我们已经设定了到2030年的宏伟目标。

sentences.en: We will reduce emissions by 33 to 35 percent.
sentences.zh: 我们将把排放量减少33%到35%。

sentences.en: And we saw much bigger willingness of countries to participate precisely because nobody was going to be holding a hammer over their head and making them meet targets and timetables.
sentences.zh: 我们看到各国参与的意愿大大增强，恰恰是因为没有人会把锤子悬在他们的头顶上逼他们去达到目标和时间表。

sentences.en: And so the result was every country in the world finally agreed, we are going to do something.
sentences.zh: 因此结果是，世界上每个国家终于达成一致：我们要采取行动。

sentences.en: We recognize this is a common obligation of humanity.
sentences.zh: 我们认识到这是全人类的共同义务。

sentences.en: We are all agreed that unless current climate trends are reverse disaster stocks, our planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 我们一致认为，除非扭转当前的气候趋势，否则灾难将危及我们的地球。

sentences.en: And that was the key to sort of getting the deal through.
sentences.zh: 这就是促成这项协议的关键所在。

sentences.en: But let's just imagine for a moment what we would have to say to our grandchildren if we failed.
sentences.zh: 但让我们想象一下，如果我们失败了，我们该对子孙后代说些什么。

sentences.en: We'd have to say it was all too difficult.
sentences.zh: 我们得说一切都太难了。

sentences.en: And they would reply, well, what was so difficult?
sentences.zh: 而他们会回答，究竟有什么难的？

sentences.en: What was it that was so difficult when the Earth was in peril?
sentences.zh: 当地球处于危急关头时，到底有什么是那么难的？

sentences.en: So what did the United States bring to the table and commit to doing with the Paris Climate Agreement?
sentences.zh: 那么，美国在《巴黎气候协定》中拿出了什么并承诺要做什么？

sentences.en: I've come here personally.
sentences.zh: 我亲自来到了这里。

sentences.en: As the leader of the world's largest economy and the second largest emitter.
sentences.zh: 作为世界最大经济体的领导人和第二大排放国的领导人。

sentences.en: To say that the United States of America not only recognizes our role in creating this problem.
sentences.zh: 我要说，美利坚合众国不仅承认我们在造成这一问题上的角色。

sentences.en: So we embrace our responsibility to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 我们也承担起采取行动解决这一问题的责任。

sentences.en: So we made a promise that we were going to, by 2025, lower our emissions by at least 26%.
sentences.zh: 因此我们作出承诺，到2025年，将我们的排放量至少减少26%。

sentences.en: In addition, we promised money for the poor countries.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们承诺向贫穷国家提供资金。

sentences.en: And as a down payment on that, President Obama pledged that the United States would spend $3 billion to contribute to something called the Green Climate Fund,
sentences.zh: 作为其中的首付，奥巴马总统承诺美国将出资30亿美元，注入一个名为“绿色气候基金”的机构，

sentences.en: which is supposed to eventually become a $100 billion a year fund that's going to help the poor countries that need it the moSt.
sentences.zh: 该基金最终应发展成为一个每年1000亿美元的基金，用于帮助最需要的贫穷国家。

sentences.en: By the time the Obama administration left office, only $1 billion of that $3 billion had actually been transferred.
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马政府卸任时，这30亿美元中实际上只有10亿美元被划拨到位。

sentences.en: Now, it's important to note that Mr. Obama was never able to win a political consensus in Congress to do what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，奥巴马先生从未能在国会赢得政治共识来做他正在做的事情。

sentences.en: And that's one reason that the Paris Agreement is kind of twisted into a pretzel shape to be a voluntary agreement,
sentences.zh: 这也是《巴黎协定》被扭曲成类似自愿协议形状的原因之一，

sentences.en: because if it had been a treaty kind of legally obligating the United States to make these emissions cuts, then he would not have been able to get it.
sentences.zh: 因为如果它是一项在法律上强制美国进行这些减排的条约，那么他是无法通过的。

sentences.en: Yeah, he wouldn't have been able to get it through Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 是的，他无法让它在国会山获得通过。

sentences.en: And so that's part of the reason that it came out structured the way it is.
sentences.zh: 这也是它最终呈现出目前这种结构的部分原因。

sentences.en: And of course, the Trump administration has said that they intend to walk away from that commitment, along with most of the other commitments we made in Paris.
sentences.zh: 当然，特朗普政府已经表示，他们打算放弃这一承诺，以及我们在巴黎做出的绝大多数其他承诺。

sentences.en: And just how essential or inessential is the United States to the Paris Climate Agreement, just its basic function?
sentences.zh: 对于《巴黎气候协定》而言，美国究竟有多核心，或者说它对其基本功能而言是不是非不可？

sentences.en: If we wind up walking away for, let's say, the four years of the Trump administration and then coming back under some new administration,
sentences.zh: 如果我们最终选择退出——比如在特朗普执政的四年里退出，然后在某个新政府上台后回归，

sentences.en: it may not be all that damaging.
sentences.zh: 可能不会造成那么大的破坏。

sentences.en: A lot of countries have said, we are going to go forward, whatever the United States does.
sentences.zh: 许多国家已经表示，无论美国做什么，我们都将继续前进。

sentences.en: Because the danger is, once we walk away, we might see a kind of a collapse in the global political will to tackle this problem.
sentences.zh: 因为危险在于，一旦我们退出，我们可能会看到解决这一问题的全球政治意愿出现某种崩溃。

sentences.en: A lot of people are going to be morally outraged, already are, at how little the United States is doing.
sentences.zh: 很多人会感到道德愤慨——事实上已经如此——因为美国做得太少。

sentences.en: And if you were India or even China, and you see that a much richer country with a much more responsibility for emissions is not doing very much,
sentences.zh: 如果你是印度甚至中国，当你看到一个承担更多减排责任的超级富裕国家并没有做太多事情时，

sentences.en: you may very well say to yourself, why should we bother?
sentences.zh: 你很可能会对自己说，我们何必自找麻烦？

sentences.en: They are beginning to see that it's in their own interest to solve this problem, but they're still going to be pretty angry.
sentences.zh: 他们开始认识到解决这个问题符合他们自身的利益，但他们仍然会非常生气。

sentences.en: And so we just don't know how this will play out exactly if the United States does indeed walk away from the Paris Agreement.
sentences.zh: 所以如果美国真的退出了《巴黎协定》，我们只是不知道局势究竟会如何发展。

sentences.en: So if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果美国

sentences.en: leaves and becomes a country that's not part of this agreement, what other countries would it be joining in that status of being outside of this agreement?
sentences.zh: 离开并成为一个不属于该协议的国家，它还将与哪些国家一起处于该协议之外的状态？

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我想想。

sentences.en: One of them is Nicaragua, I think, who thought that the agreement was not ambitious enough, and that's the reason they didn't sign it.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是尼加拉瓜，我想，他们认为该协议的雄心还不够大，这就是他们没有签署的原因。

sentences.en: And the other is Syria, I think, which is in the middle of a civil war, and you can imagine they have other bigger problems on their mind right now.
sentences.zh: 另一个是叙利亚，我想，它正处于内战之中，你可以想象他们现在脑子里有更重要的问题要操心。

sentences.en: But pretty much literally every other country in the world is party to the agreement and willing to go forward, they say, right now.
sentences.zh: 但几乎可以说，世界上所有其他国家都是该协议的缔约方，并且表示他们现在就愿意向前推进。

sentences.en: Finally, Justin, as you said, this entire agreement is predicated on countries pressuring one another to essentially do the right thing, according to those involved.
sentences.zh: 最后，贾斯汀，正如你所说，整个协议的基础是各国相互施压，促使彼此根据有关各方的意见实质性地做正确的事。

sentences.en: So what happens to that model, that kind of organizing global principle, when the country that has contributed most to carbon emissions
sentences.zh: 那么，当那个对碳排放贡献最大的国家

sentences.en: says that it doesn't care about that peer pressure and stops applying that pressure to everyone else?
sentences.zh: 表示它不在乎这种同辈压力并不再向所有人施加这种压力时，那种模式、那种组织全球的原则会发生什么变化？

sentences.en: We may say we don't care, but I mean, I think in reality, we are going to wind up as the naughty kid in the back of the schoolroom,
sentences.zh: 我们可能会说不在乎，但我的意思是，我认为在现实中，我们最终会沦落为教室后排那个调皮的孩子，

sentences.en: you know, wearing the dust cap while everybody else, you know, shows up at the front and shows their beautiful homework.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，戴着笨蛋帽，而其他所有人，你知道的，都走到前面展示他们漂亮的家庭作业。

sentences.en: And so there's going to be a lot of sort of finger pointing and blame at the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，将会有很多针对美国的指责和责备。

sentences.en: I don't think if we walk away that we will win ourselves any friends internationally.
sentences.zh: 我不认为如果我们退出，能在国际上赢得任何朋友。

sentences.en: That's absolutely clear.
sentences.zh: 这是绝对显而易见的。

sentences.en: We've become a bit of a pariah in global negotiations on all sorts of issues.
sentences.zh: 在各种议题的国际谈判中，我们已经变得有点像个同义词般的异类。

sentences.en: You know, and we saw that just with the recent G7 summit in Italy, where President Trump was essentially having every other leader of the industrial world
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们在最近于意大利举行的G7峰会上就看到了这一点，当时特朗普总统基本上让工业化世界的其他每一位领导人

sentences.en: kind of wagging their finger in his face about this issue.
sentences.zh: 都针对这个问题指着他的鼻子训斥。

sentences.en: I think you can expect a lot more of that in the coming years.
sentences.zh: 我想在未来几年里，你可以期待看到更多类似的情景。

sentences.en: Justin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it, especially given that you're sitting in a car in the same position talking to us.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激，特别是考虑到你正坐在车里保持着同一个姿势跟我们聊天。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Is the peer pressure model we've been talking about with the Paris Climate Accord something we see much of in international relations?
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论的关于《巴黎气候协定》的同辈压力模式，在国际关系中常见吗？

sentences.en: So it absolutely is.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: There's this idea that the way the international system is supposed to work is that to be a nation in good standing, you have to just behave in certain ways and meet certain norMs.
sentences.zh: 有这样一种观点，即国际系统的运作方式应该是：要想成为一个表现良好的国家，你只需以某些特定方式行事并达到某些规范。

sentences.en: And peer pressure is a really good way to think about it because it's a lot like, in many ways, any other social group.
sentences.zh: 同辈压力是思考这个问题的一个非常好的切入点，因为它在很多方面与其他任何社交群体非常相似。

sentences.en: My colleagues Amanda Taub and Max Fisher write the interpreter column for The Times.
sentences.zh: 我的同事阿曼达·陶布和马克斯·费舍尔为《时报》撰写“解读”专栏。

sentences.en: You don't go to jail if you violate one of these norms, but it reduces your standing within the group.
sentences.zh: 如果你违反了这些规范之一，你不会进监狱，但它会降低你在群体中的地位。

sentences.en: It means that next time you want something and you want to get international cooperation on something that's important to you, it's harder.
sentences.zh: 这意味着下次你想要点什么、想要在对你重要的事务上获得国际合作时，会变得更加困难。

sentences.en: And by and large, this has been a pretty good system throughout the post-World War II order.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，在整个二战后的国际秩序中，这一直是一个相当不错的系统。

sentences.en: I would bet any amount of money that you, Michael Babar, recycle.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌，你，迈克尔·巴巴罗，一定会回收垃圾。

sentences.en: Why do you recycle?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要回收垃圾？

sentences.en: It's generally seen in my building in New York City as the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 在我在纽约市的楼里，这通常被视为正确的事情。

sentences.en: And there are plastic bags you have to put out so people can literally see if you've done it.
sentences.zh: 而且有些塑料袋必须摆出来，这样别人一眼就能看出你到底有没有这么做。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: So it's like if you recycle or don't recycle, actually has no bearing whatsoever on the environment.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比你回不回收垃圾，其实对环境没有任何影响。

sentences.en: Recycling only works if everybody does it.
sentences.zh: 垃圾回收只有在人人都做的时候才有用。

sentences.en: So the same with the international community, things like climate or like the agreement against
sentences.zh: 国际社会也是如此，比如气候问题或者反对

sentences.en: using chemical weapons, nuclear proliferation, these only work if everybody participates, much like recycling.
sentences.zh: 使用化学武器、防止核扩散的协议，这些只有在每个人都参与时才起作用，就像垃圾回收一样。

sentences.en: But like these international agreements, like your life would be better and easier if you just didn't recycle and you just threw your stuff away.
sentences.zh: 但就像这些国际协议一样，如果你不回收垃圾、直接把东西扔掉，你的生活实际上会更好、更轻松。

sentences.en: And that would actually, you could free ride on the system of everyone else recycling.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你完全可以在其他人都在进行垃圾回收的系统里搭便车。

sentences.en: Actually pretty similar to the way international agreements work.
sentences.zh: 其实这和国际协议的运作方式非常相似。

sentences.en: To this recycling metaphor, one of my favorite studies on this is there were a series of experiments to try to figure out what would make people recycle.
sentences.zh: 说到这个垃圾回收的比喻，我最喜欢的研究之一就是曾做过的一系列实验，试图弄清楚是什么能促使人们回收垃圾。

sentences.en: And some of them, they would pass out little signs or flyers that would say, you know, recycling saves the earth.
sentences.zh: 在其中一些实验中，他们会分发小标语或传单，上面写着：你知道的，垃圾回收能拯救地球。

sentences.en: Recycling is really important.
sentences.zh: 垃圾回收非常重要。

sentences.en: And then another group got flyers that said, your neighbors are recycling.
sentences.zh: 然后另一组收到的传单上写着：你的邻居都在回收垃圾。

sentences.en: Like most people in this neighborhood recycle 85% of recyclable materials.
sentences.zh: 比如这个社区的大多数人都回收85%的可回收材料。

sentences.en: Um, and that second group, it was much more effective in getting people to recycle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第二组在促使人们回收垃圾方面要有效得多。

sentences.en: And this experiment has been tried in all kinds of different contexts.
sentences.zh: 这个实验已经在各种不同的背景下进行过测试。

sentences.en: There was another one.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个实验。

sentences.en: I'm sure a lot of people have seen this.
sentences.zh: 我相信很多人都见过这个。

sentences.en: When you go to a hotel, sometimes there's a little sign in the bathroom that says we've saved water because 70% of hotel guests don't need new towels every day.
sentences.zh: 当你去酒店时，有时浴室里会有一个小标志，上面写着我们节约了水，因为70%的酒店客人不需要每天换新毛巾。

sentences.en: Are you part of the 70%?
sentences.zh: 你是那70%中的一员吗？

sentences.en: Are you part of the 70%?
sentences.zh: 你是那70%中的一员吗？

sentences.en: So I'm, I'm in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在在纽约。

sentences.en: I'm staying in a hotel right now.
sentences.zh: 我正住在一家酒店里。

sentences.en: I did not request new towels because I don't want to be, you know, violating social norms of my group.
sentences.zh: 我没有要求换新毛巾，因为我不想，你知道的，违背我所在群体的社会规范。

sentences.en: So in an international realm, what are models and examples of when this makes sense and functions?
sentences.zh: 那么在国际领域，这种情况合乎情理并起作用的模式和例子有哪些？

sentences.en: One good example, I think, is the international refugee system where everybody acknowledges that people are displaced by conflict and other disasters.
sentences.zh: 我认为一个很好的例子就是国际难民体系，每个人都承认人们因冲突和其他灾难而流离失所。

sentences.en: They need somewhere to go.
sentences.zh: 他们需要有个去处。

sentences.en: So after World War II, they put together the refugee treaty, stated every country's obligation.
sentences.zh: 所以在二战后，他们制定了难民条约，规定了每个国家的义务。

sentences.en: And since then has become a really powerful norm.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，它已经成为一种非常强大的规范。

sentences.en: There's no specific punishment.
sentences.zh: 这里没有具体的惩罚。

sentences.en: It's not like you get sanctioned if you're not nice enough to refugees, but it is part
sentences.zh: 如果你对难民不够好，你不会受到制裁，但它是你对其他国家义务的一部分，

sentences.en: of kind of your obligation to the other countries and being part of the group matters, like following social norms really matters.
sentences.zh: 而且作为群体的一部分至关重要，就像遵守社会规范至关重要一样。

sentences.en: And the idea is that there are benefits to being part of this international system.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念是，成为这个国际体系的一部分是有好处的。

sentences.en: So maybe you do your part on refugees and the next time you need something from the international community, you're more likely to be able to rely on them.
sentences.zh: 所以也许你在难民问题上尽了你的本分，而下次当你需要国际社会的帮助时，你更有可能依靠他们。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think all of these things work together into this big experiment that we've been trying
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为所有这些因素共同构成了我们自1945年以来一直在尝试的伟大实验，

sentences.en: since 1945 of completely reorganizing the world around the idea of international collective cooperation on major issues.
sentences.zh: 即围绕在重大问题上开展国际集体合作的理念，彻底重组整个世界。

sentences.en: So part of the reason that countries participate in all of them is like maybe you don't care
sentences.zh: 因此，国家参与所有这一切的部分原因在于，作为一个主权国家，也许你并不那么关心

sentences.en: so much about, say, migrant issues as a state, but you really care about climate because that really affects you.
sentences.zh: 诸如移民问题之类的事情，但你确实非常关心气候，因为这真的会影响到你。

sentences.en: And you want to have this larger system where you're kind of like in the room with the other countries participating in this set of agreements.
sentences.zh: 而且你希望拥有这样一个更大的系统，在其中你就像是和参与这组协议的其他国家共处一室。

sentences.en: All of these are about taking steps towards building this big international cooperation norm.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是为了采取步骤，建立这种大型的国际合作规范。

sentences.en: And that's part of why it's so dangerous to break with the entire premise that it's good to cooperate, which is what President Trump is doing and is very unusual.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么打破“合作是件好事”这一整体前提会如此危险的部分原因，而这正是特朗普总统正在做的，非常不寻常。

sentences.en: I'm interested in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我对美国很感兴趣。

sentences.en: in particular, which thinks of itself, ourself, as exceptional.
sentences.zh: 特别是美国，它自视为、我们自己视为例外的存在。

sentences.en: It's a word used all the time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经常被使用的词。

sentences.en: Is the United States more reluctant than other countries to participate in this peer pressure system of international relations?
sentences.zh: 与其他国家相比，美国是否更不愿参与这种国际关系的同辈压力系统？

sentences.en: So the interesting thing about the United States is that actually since this country's
sentences.zh: 关于美国，有趣的是，其实自这个国家

sentences.en: founding, we have in many, many situations been one of the strongest proponents of this system
sentences.zh: 建立以来，我们在许许多多的情况下都是这个系统最坚定的支持者之一

sentences.en: from, like, the earliest days of the Constitution, our earliest laws, there was a big deal about
sentences.zh: 从宪法早期、我们最早的法律开始，就非常强调

sentences.en: international law being part of our law, that the United States was going to be kind of a member of this community of nations.
sentences.zh: 国际法是我们法律的一部分，美国将成为这个国家共同体的一个成员。

sentences.en: And it was because we were a new country that had just come into being because there had just been a revolution.
sentences.zh: 正是因为我们是一个刚刚诞生的新国家，刚刚经历了一场革命。

sentences.en: And it was a way of punching above our weight and legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 这是我们超越自身实力和增强合法性的一种方式。

sentences.en: The United States is now a superpower.
sentences.zh: 美国现在是一个超级大国。

sentences.en: It's not a small country trying to punch above its weight.
sentences.zh: 它不再是一个试图超越自身体量的小国。

sentences.en: But I think that this has always been something that's pretty important.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这一直是一件非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: Well, especially since we've been a superpower.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特别是自从我们成为超级大国以来。

sentences.en: I mean, this is part of what I think so puzzles a lot of people about President Trump's desire
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这也是我认为让很多人对特朗普总统想要

sentences.en: to break with this, is that the United States really was a major party in building this international system.
sentences.zh: 打破这一局面的愿望感到不解的部分原因，因为美国确实是构建这个国际体系的主要参与者。

sentences.en: And it serves us because we're the top of the system.
sentences.zh: 这对我们有利，因为我们处于这个体系的顶端。

sentences.en: This is interesting because this came up in our earlier conversation with our colleague
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为这在我们之前与同事

sentences.en: Justin Gillis.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀·吉利斯的交谈中提到过。

sentences.en: Are you suggesting, Max, that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 马克斯，你是说美国

sentences.en: disproportionately benefited from international cooperative peer pressure model of how to get along, but is now essentially starting to forsake it?
sentences.zh: 从关于如何相处的国际合作同辈压力模式中获得了不相称的好处，但现在基本上开始抛弃它了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I mean, Trump has been quite explicit about just not believing in this model.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普对于不相信这种模式一直表现得很直白。

sentences.en: There was an op-ed that I actually wrote down because it was such an amazing quote by H.R.
sentences.zh: 我甚至记下了一篇专栏文章，因为国家安全顾问H.R.

sentences.en: McMaster's, the National Security Advisor, and Gary Cohn, who's the president of the NAC, the National Economic Council, this op-ed about the Europe trip.
sentences.zh: 麦克马斯特和国家经济委员会（NAC）主席加里·科恩的这段引言太精彩了，这是关于欧洲之行的一篇专栏文章。

sentences.en: The president embarked on his first foreign trip with a clear-eyed outlook that the world is not
sentences.zh: 总统开始他的首次海外访问时，带着一种清醒的看法，即世界不是

sentences.en: a global community, which they have in quotes, but an arena where nations, non-governmental actors, and business engage compete for advantage.
sentences.zh: 一个全球共同体（他们用了引号），而是一个国家、非政府行动者和企业为了利益展开竞争的竞技场。

sentences.en: Just translate that.
sentences.zh: 简单翻译一下。

sentences.en: What they are saying is that forever in American foreign policy, we've built everything around the idea that we're better off cooperating in a global community of nations of which
sentences.zh: 他们所说的是，在美利坚合众国外交政策的漫长历史中，我们建立一切的基础都是这样一个理念：我们在一个由各国组成的全球共同体中合作会过得更好，而

sentences.en: we are the first and most important and to some degree leading member.
sentences.zh: 我们是其中第一、最重要并在某种程度上领先的成员。

sentences.en: In fact, we are going to jostle and compete against every other nation.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们要与所有其他国家发生摩擦并展开竞争。

sentences.en: I mean, this is an idea that died in 1945 and that the United States helped to kill.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个在1945年破产的理念，而美国曾协助将其埋葬。

sentences.en: After two successive world wars.
sentences.zh: 在经历两次连续的世界大战之后。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is an essential question.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个至关重要的问题。

sentences.en: Are we possibly, globally, in a moment where nationalism risks trumping this old model we've been talking about of peer pressure-based diplomacy and cooperation?
sentences.zh: 我们是否可能在全球范围内迎来这样一个时刻：民族主义有风险会战胜我们一直在讨论的这种基于同辈压力的外交和合作旧模式？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, nationalism has always been a thing and there have always been nations that
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，民族主义一直存在，而且总会有一些国家

sentences.en: are dissidents from this kind of international cooperation, like Russia and China have always kind of cut against it some days and then worked with it others.
sentences.zh: 是这种国际合作的异见者，比如俄罗斯和中国，有时会逆潮流而动，有时又会与之合作。

sentences.en: What's unusual and untested, so we don't know what's going to happen, is the United States being actively against the thing that they built for so long.
sentences.zh: 不寻常且未经检验的是——所以我们不知道会发生什么——美国竟然积极反对他们苦心经营了这么久的事物。

sentences.en: But when we think about something like the European Union and Britain's decision to leave it, it suggests that we're not just talking about the United States as a nationalist actor
sentences.zh: 但当我们想到诸如欧盟以及英国决定脱欧之类的事情时，它表明我们讨论的不仅仅是作为民族主义行动者的美国

sentences.en: stepping away from this model you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 正步出你所说的这种模式。

sentences.en: It seems like a broader based kind of crisis of confidence around this whole model.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是对整个模式更广泛的信心危机。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of question is like, because this experiment of international integration is really new.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个问题所在，因为国际一体化的这种实验真的是全新的。

sentences.en: Like, we don't have a lot of other case studies to look at.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们没有太多其他案例研究可供参考。

sentences.en: Is this just a thing where there's going to be kind of two steps forward, one step back, which has been mostly how it's worked so far?
sentences.zh: 这只是一种前进两步、后退一步的情况吗，这基本上也是迄今为止它的运作方式？

sentences.en: Or is this a case of the entire model being now thrown into question because some of its most powerful members, not just the United States and Britain, but also Russia and China
sentences.zh: 还是说，整个模式现在都受到了质疑，因为其一些最强大的成员——不仅仅是美国和英国，还有俄罗斯和中国——

sentences.en: are starting to question a lot of ways?
sentences.zh: 开始在很多方面提出质疑？

sentences.en: I think those are both real possibilities.
sentences.zh: 我认为这两种都是现实存在的可能性。

sentences.en: Amanda and Max, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达和马克斯，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: The Times reports that President Trump has been receiving conflicting advice on whether the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，特朗普总统一直在就美国是否应

sentences.en: should leave the Paris Climate Accord.
sentences.zh: 退出《巴黎气候协定》听取相互矛盾的建议。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, Trump met with former Exxon chief executive, now Secretary of State
sentences.zh: 周三下午，特朗普会见了前埃克森美孚首席执行官、现任国务卿

sentences.en: Rex Tillerson, who wants to stay in the accord.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森，他希望留在协定中。

sentences.en: But the president and his team campaigned on a promise to leave it.
sentences.zh: 但总统和他的团队在竞选时曾承诺要退出该协定。

sentences.en: We're going to cancel the Paris Climate Agreement.
sentences.zh: 我们将废除《巴黎气候协定》。

sentences.en: Staying in the accord, Trump has said, would harm the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾表示，留在协定中会损害美国

sentences.en: economy and hurt job creation in regions like Appalachia and the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 经济，并损害阿巴拉契亚和西部等地区的就业增长。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the president sent out this tweet.
sentences.zh: 周三晚间，总统发布了这条推文。

sentences.en: Quote, I will be announcing my decision on Paris Accord Thursday at 3 p.m.
sentences.zh: 引述：我将于周日下午3点在巴黎协定上宣布我的决定。

sentences.en: The White House Rose Garden.
sentences.zh: 白宫玫瑰园。

sentences.en: Make America great again.
sentences.zh: 让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: A massive truck bomb exploded outside the presidential palace in Afghanistan on Wednesday morning,
sentences.zh: 周三上午，阿富汗总统府外发生了一起大规模卡车炸弹爆炸事件，

sentences.en: killing at least 80 people and wounding more than 450 in a high-security neighborhood of
sentences.zh: 在喀布尔的一个高度安全社区中造成至少80人死亡，450多人受伤。

sentences.en: Kabul.
sentences.zh: 喀布尔。

sentences.en: The blast comes as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 爆炸发生之际，美国

sentences.en: is considering sending more troops to Afghanistan to fight Taliban forces that have regained territory in recent months.
sentences.zh: 正考虑向阿富汗派遣更多军队，以打击近几个月来收复失地的塔利班武装分子。

sentences.en: Security agencies had warned that both the Taliban and ISIS were planning major attacks in Kabul.
sentences.zh: 安全机构曾警告称，塔利班和伊斯兰国都计划在喀布尔发动重大袭击。

sentences.en: And, I mean, as I sit here on the eve of, excuse me, on the eve of one of the greatest sporting events that we have in sports.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，当我坐在这里，值此——对不起，值此我们体育界最伟大的体育赛事之一的前夕。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the day before he's set to play in his seventh straight NBA finals,
sentences.zh: 周三，也就是他准备连续第七次参加NBA总决赛的前一天，

sentences.en: LeBron James spoke out about an act of vandalism that police are investigating as a hate crime.
sentences.zh: 勒布朗·詹姆斯就一起被警方作为仇恨犯罪进行调查的蓄意破坏行为发声。

sentences.en: A racial slur that was spray-painted on his home in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 一个带有种族歧视色彩的词被喷漆写在了他位于洛杉矶的家中。

sentences.en: No matter how much money you have, no matter how famous you are, no matter how many people admire you,
sentences.zh: 无论你有多少钱，无论你多么出名，无论有多少人崇拜你，

sentences.en: you know, being black in America is tough.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在美国做黑人很难。

sentences.en: And we got a long way to go,
sentences.zh: 我们还有很长的路要走，

sentences.en: you know, for us as a society and for us as African Americans until we feel equal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论是作为一个社会还是作为非裔美国人，直到我们感到平等。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。
